name: Ryoujoku ~Suki Desu ka?~
source:
The protagonist, who works an assistant director (AD) for a television programme, is in huge debt and spends the days in fear of the debt collectors to arrive on his doorstep.

Here, Shinozaki Chihiro, an ace producer, offers him dangerous proposition.

"––Go rape some celebrities and record the videos."

Since pulling through with such a demand would void his debt, the protagonist becomes intrigued by said proposition.

Shinozaki wants to use those videos to blackmail famous celebrities and force them to participate in her TV productions.

Spurred on by this mission, the protagonist's descent into a lustful beast has begun...

[Translated from the [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ002798.html/?unique_op=af]DLSite[/url]]
